latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of the WeChat Mini Program development skill.

- Provides a comprehensive guide for WeChat Mini Program development from beginner to advanced levels.
- Includes official documentation links, project structure explanation, and key concepts.
- Covers configuration, page registration, template syntax, common APIs, and custom components.
- Lists important notes for development such as domain configuration, HTTPS requirements, code size limits, and user privacy.
- Offers quick reference resources for further study.
